sources.officialName: Reserve Bank of India Official Portal
sources.publisher: Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
sources.sourceType: Central Bank and Financial System Regulator
sources.accessLimitations: Public, unauthenticated
sources.reviewFrequency: Daily monitoring of Master Directions and Notifications
sources.changeDetectionMethod: RSS and official Notification feed inspection
sources.notes: Authoritative for monetary policy, repo corridor, banking regulations, digital lending guidelines, NBFC-P2P rules, FEMA circulars, and G-Sec Retail Direct.

sources.officialName: RBI Complaint Management System & Integrated Ombudsman Scheme
sources.publisher: Reserve Bank of India
sources.sourceType: Statutory Financial Ombudsman Redressal Portal
sources.accessLimitations: Public web portal for filing and tracking ombudsman complaints
sources.reviewFrequency: Monthly
sources.changeDetectionMethod: Portal FAQ and annual ombudsman report tracking
sources.notes: Governs the Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2021 covering commercial banks, NBFCs, and non-bank prepaid payment issuers.

sources.officialName: Securities and Exchange Board of India Portal
sources.publisher: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
sources.sourceType: Statutory Securities and Capital Markets Regulator
sources.accessLimitations: Public, unauthenticated
sources.reviewFrequency: Daily circular and board meeting press release monitoring
sources.notes: Authoritative for Mutual Fund categorization, REIT/InvIT regulations, AIF guidelines, F&O risk circulars, algorithmic trading norms, and insider trading prohibitions.

sources.officialName: SEBI Complaints Redress System (SCORES 2.0) and SMART ODR
sources.publisher: Securities and Exchange Board of India
sources.sourceType: Statutory Securities Grievance and Online Dispute Resolution Portal
sources.accessLimitations: Public grievance portal and SMART ODR arbitration interface
sources.reviewFrequency: Quarterly
sources.changeDetectionMethod: SCORES circulars and portal user guide releases
sources.notes: Covers SCORES 2.0 automated escalation workflows and SMART ODR institutional conciliation and arbitration.

sources.officialName: Central Board of Direct Taxes & Income Tax Department Portal
sources.publisher: Central Board of Direct Taxes, Ministry of Finance
sources.sourceType: Primary Statutory Direct Tax Authority
sources.accessLimitations: Public, unauthenticated
sources.reviewFrequency: Daily monitoring of circulars, notifications, and gazette orders
sources.notes: Authoritative for Income-tax Act 1961, Section 115BAC slabs, capital gains rules under Finance Act 2024, Section 269SS/ST cash penalties, and Section 50C circle rate safe harbor.

sources.officialName: Income Tax e-Filing Portal (Project Insight)
sources.publisher: Income Tax Department, Government of India
sources.sourceType: Statutory Tax Filing, AIS/TIS, and Compliance Portal
sources.accessLimitations: Public utility schemas; individual authenticated PAN/Aadhaar dashboards
sources.reviewFrequency: Bi-weekly schema and utility release tracking
sources.notes: Authoritative for Annual Information Statement (AIS), Taxpayer Information Summary (TIS), 26AS reflection, Advance Tax challans, and Form 67 filings.

sources.officialName: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs Portal
sources.publisher: Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance
sources.sourceType: Primary Statutory Indirect Tax and Customs Authority
sources.accessLimitations: Public, unauthenticated
sources.reviewFrequency: Weekly circular and GST Council meeting minutes tracking
sources.notes: Authoritative for CGST/IGST Acts, export of services without tax under LUT, reverse charge mechanism (RCM), and precious metal customs import duties.

sources.officialName: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation Portal
sources.publisher: DICGC (Wholly Owned Subsidiary of RBI)
sources.sourceType: Statutory Deposit Insurance Authority
sources.accessLimitations: Public, unauthenticated
sources.reviewFrequency: Monthly insured bank list and claim payout audit
sources.changeDetectionMethod: DICGC Insured Banks Registry and Press Release monitoring
sources.notes: Authoritative for DICGC Act 1961, Section 18A 90-day resolution payments, ₹5 Lakh per depositor per bank ceiling, and right/capacity ownership rules.

sources.officialName: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
sources.sourceType: Statutory Social Security and Provident Fund Authority
sources.accessLimitations: Public guidelines; Unified Member Portal for authenticated passbooks
sources.reviewFrequency: Monthly Board of Trustees circular reviews
sources.notes: Authoritative for EPF Scheme 1952, EPS 1995, annual statutory interest rate declarations, ₹15,000 wage ceilings, and Section 10(11)/10(12) tax segregation.

sources.officialName: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority Portal
sources.publisher: PFRDA, Government of India
sources.sourceType: Statutory National Pension System Regulator
sources.accessLimitations: Public, unauthenticated
sources.reviewFrequency: Monthly regulatory circular tracking
sources.changeDetectionMethod: PFRDA Master Regulations and Circulars index
sources.notes: Authoritative for NPS Tier I/II architecture, Pension Fund Manager guidelines, Auto vs Active choice, 60% lump sum exit, and mandatory annuity directives.

sources.officialName: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India Portal
sources.publisher: IRDAI
sources.sourceType: Statutory Insurance Sector Regulator
sources.accessLimitations: Public, unauthenticated
sources.reviewFrequency: Bi-weekly master circular and product filing regulation monitoring
sources.changeDetectionMethod: IRDAI Notifications and Master Circulars portal
sources.notes: Authoritative for Insurance Act 1938, Section 45 claim repudiation moratorium, health insurance room-rent regulations, and Bima Bharosa escalation.

sources.officialName: Council for Insurance Ombudsmen Portal
sources.publisher: Executive Council of Insurers / Ministry of Finance
sources.sourceType: Statutory Insurance Dispute Adjudication Portal
sources.accessLimitations: Public complaint lodgement and published awards database
sources.reviewFrequency: Quarterly
sources.notes: Authoritative for statutory insurance complaint awards up to ₹30 Lakh, binding on insurers under Insurance Ombudsman Rules 2017.

sources.officialName: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sources.sourceType: Union Ministry Governing Economic & Small Savings Policy
sources.accessLimitations: Public, unauthenticated
sources.reviewFrequency: Quarterly small savings interest rate order tracking
sources.notes: Authoritative for quarterly PPF, SSY, SCSS, and NSC interest notifications, sovereign borrowing calendars, and Union Budget publications.

sources.officialName: Department of Posts (India Post) National Savings Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Communications, Government of India
sources.sourceType: Statutory Small Savings Scheme Operator
sources.accessLimitations: Public post office operational guidelines
sources.reviewFrequency: Monthly
sources.changeDetectionMethod: India Post Financial Services rules portal
sources.notes: Authoritative for Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS), POTD deposit terms, joint account limits, and postal branch transfer rules.

sources.officialName: National Payments Corporation of India Portal
sources.publisher: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)
sources.sourceType: Umbrella Organization for Retail Digital Payments in India
sources.accessLimitations: Public circulars and operational statistics
sources.reviewFrequency: Weekly circular and product specification tracking
sources.notes: Authoritative for UPI transaction limits, interchange circulars, RuPay specifications, IMPS settlement parameters, and NACH e-mandate guidelines.

sources.officialName: Ministry of Corporate Affairs Portal (MCA21)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
sources.sourceType: Statutory Corporate and Company Law Authority
sources.accessLimitations: Public company master data; statutory fee for certified document copies
sources.reviewFrequency: Bi-weekly MCA notifications and circulars tracking
sources.changeDetectionMethod: MCA Notifications and Companies Act rule amendments index
sources.notes: Authoritative for Companies Act 2013, LLP Act 2008, corporate share buyback approvals, director identification numbers (DIN), and incorporation compliance.

sources.officialName: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India Portal
sources.publisher: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI)
sources.sourceType: Statutory Insolvency and Resolution Authority
sources.accessLimitations: Public insolvency orders and regulations
sources.reviewFrequency: Monthly resolution orders and regulatory amendment tracking
sources.notes: Authoritative for Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016 (IBC), corporate insolvency resolution process (CIRP), and creditor waterfall rankings.

sources.officialName: Directorate of Enforcement (ED) Portal
sources.publisher: Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance
sources.sourceType: Statutory Economic Intelligence and Anti-Money Laundering Enforcement Agency
sources.accessLimitations: Public press releases, attachment orders, and statutory notifications
sources.reviewFrequency: Weekly enforcement press release monitoring
sources.changeDetectionMethod: ED Press Release and PMLA attachment registry
sources.notes: Authoritative for Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002 (PMLA), FEMA criminal penalties, hawala operations prosecution, and provisional property attachment.

sources.officialName: Financial Intelligence Unit - India Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sources.sourceType: National Financial Intelligence and Anti-Money Laundering Agency
sources.accessLimitations: Public compliance circulars and reporting entity guidelines
sources.reviewFrequency: Monthly AML circular reviews
sources.notes: Authoritative for Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs), Cash Transaction Reports (CTRs), and reporting entity compliance under PMLA.

sources.officialName: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (I4C)
sources.publisher: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), Ministry of Home Affairs
sources.sourceType: Central Cyber Financial Fraud Reporting Infrastructure
sources.accessLimitations: Public emergency helpline 1930 and victim reporting interface
sources.reviewFrequency: Bi-weekly fraud typology and alert tracking
sources.changeDetectionMethod: I4C Cybercrime advisories and Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting System alerts
sources.notes: Authoritative for National Cyber Fraud Helpline 1930, mule account lien freezing procedures, and APK loan app advisories.

sources.officialName: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act State Portals
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / State RERA Authorities
sources.sourceType: Statutory Real Estate Regulatory Framework
sources.jurisdiction: India / Central Act & State Authorities (MahaRERA, UP RERA, Karnataka RERA, etc.)
sources.accessLimitations: Public state RERA project registrations and adjudicating officer orders
sources.reviewFrequency: Monthly state RERA circular monitoring
sources.notes: Authoritative for RERA 70% separate escrow account requirements, carpet area definitions, promoter delivery obligations, and interest compensation.

sources.officialName: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (e-Daakhil)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
sources.sourceType: Statutory Consumer Dispute Adjudication Tribunal
sources.accessLimitations: Public case judgments and e-Daakhil filing portal
sources.reviewFrequency: Quarterly landmark judgment tracking
sources.notes: Authoritative for Consumer Protection Act 2019 deficiency jurisprudence, real estate builder delay refunds, and bank service negligence compensation.

sources.officialName: India Code Digital Legislative Repository
sources.publisher: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice
sources.sourceType: Official Consolidated Repository of Central Acts and Rules
sources.accessLimitations: Public, unauthenticated
sources.reviewFrequency: Continuous legislative amendment tracking
sources.notes: Authoritative text for Indian Succession Act 1925, Hindu Succession Act 1956, Transfer of Property Act 1882, Indian Trusts Act 1882, Benami Transactions Act, and BUDS Act 2019.

sources.officialName: Supreme Court of India Official Judgments Portal
sources.publisher: Supreme Court of India
sources.sourceType: Apex Judicial Authority of India
sources.accessLimitations: Public judgment search and case status
sources.reviewFrequency: Monthly Constitutional and Civil Bench review tracking
sources.notes: Authoritative precedent on nominee versus legal heirship rights (Sarbati Devi, Ram Chander Talwar, Shakti Yezdani rulings) and Section 45 insurance precedents.

sources.officialName: International Financial Services Centres Authority Portal
sources.publisher: IFSCA, Government of India
sources.sourceType: Unified Statutory Regulator for IFSC GIFT City
sources.jurisdiction: International Financial Services Centres (GIFT City, Gujarat)
sources.accessLimitations: Public regulations and circulars
sources.reviewFrequency: Monthly circular monitoring
sources.notes: Authoritative for GIFT City banking units, outbound investment funds, global in-house centres, and dollar-denominated cross-border instruments.

sources.officialName: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation Portal
sources.publisher: National Statistical Office (NSO), MoSPI
sources.sourceType: National Statistical and Inflation Data Authority
sources.accessLimitations: Public statistical releases and press releases
sources.reviewFrequency: Monthly Consumer Price Index (CPI) release on the 12th of each month
sources.notes: Authoritative for official Consumer Price Index (CPI Combined, Rural, Urban), Index of Industrial Production (IIP), and Gross Domestic Product (GDP) prints.

sources.officialName: Association of Mutual Funds in India Portal
sources.publisher: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI)
sources.sourceType: Recognized Mutual Fund Industry Association
sources.accessLimitations: Public daily NAV text files and monthly industry AUM statistics
sources.reviewFrequency: Daily NAV sync; monthly folio flow tracking
sources.changeDetectionMethod: AMFI Open NAV portal text feeds
sources.notes: Authoritative for scheme category historical NAV feeds, AMFI Code of Ethics, distributor ARN regulations, and industry AUM trends.

sources.officialName: National Stock Exchange of India Official Portal
sources.publisher: National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE)
sources.sourceType: Recognized Stock Exchange & Market Infrastructure Institution
sources.accessLimitations: Public Bhavcopy and end-of-day reports; real-time feeds require licensed API
sources.reviewFrequency: Daily Bhavcopy audit and circular tracking
sources.changeDetectionMethod: NSE Circulars and Market Activity reports
sources.notes: Authoritative for NIFTY 50 index rules, settlement holiday calendars, derivative lot size adjustments, circuit filter guidelines, and exchange RFQ executions.

sources.officialName: Bombay Stock Exchange Official Portal
sources.publisher: BSE Limited
sources.sourceType: Recognized Stock Exchange & Market Infrastructure Institution
sources.accessLimitations: Public corporate announcements and end-of-day market data
sources.reviewFrequency: Daily corporate filing tracking
sources.notes: Authoritative for SENSEX index rules, SME exchange listings, listed company financial results disclosures, and corporate buyback notices.

sources.officialName: TransUnion CIBIL Official Portal
sources.publisher: TransUnion CIBIL Limited (Licensed by RBI)
sources.sourceType: RBI-Licensed Credit Information Company
sources.accessLimitations: One free annual credit report under RBI mandate; authenticated consumer dashboard
sources.reviewFrequency: Quarterly scoring factor updates
sources.notes: Authoritative for credit score ranges (300 to 900), credit report dispute resolution rules under CICRA 2005, and credit utilization parameters.

sources.officialName: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Portal
sources.publisher: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Limited (MCX)
sources.sourceType: Recognized Commodity Derivatives Exchange
sources.accessLimitations: Public daily contract specifications and settlement prices
sources.reviewFrequency: Weekly margin circular review
sources.notes: Authoritative for gold, silver, crude oil, and natural gas domestic futures specifications, contract settlement calendars, and physical delivery norms.

sources.officialName: Bureau of Indian Standards Hallmarking Portal
sources.publisher: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)
sources.sourceType: Statutory National Standards Body of India
sources.accessLimitations: Public BIS Care verification app and portal guidelines
sources.reviewFrequency: Quarterly mandatory hallmarking district expansion audit
sources.notes: Authoritative for 6-digit alphanumeric Hallmarking Unique Identification (HUID), gold purity standards (999, 916, 750, 585), and consumer assaying rights.
